name: SebLague/Procedural-Planets
description: A Unity-based procedural planet generator using layered noise functions, LOD spherical mesh generation, and biome-based surface coloring. Companion to a popular educational YouTube series on procedural generation techniques.
score_rationale: Highly educational Unity reference implementation with thousands of learners and clear pedagogical code structure.
summary: Educational Unity planet generator with LOD mesh and biome-based coloring with YouTube series.
